source.scope: real stdio handshake, published schemas and static describe

tools.name: astra.create_room
tools.description: Create an empty room as a local Mergence scene JSON, ready to import into the workbench and arrange equipment. Dimensions are meters. Does not modify the open browser room or save to cloud.

tools.name: astra.list_rooms
tools.description: List rooms created through this local MCP checkout.

tools.name: astra.read_room
tools.description: Read a room created through this local MCP checkout, including its portable scene document.

id.description: Room ID returned by create_room or list_rooms.

tools.name: astra.list_scene_assets
tools.description: List ready assets owned by the signed-in CLI account and bundled cleanroom examples. Requires explicit ASTRA_SCENE_TOOLS_ENABLED=true setup. Use inspect_scene_asset for dimensions and animation part IDs.

tools.name: astra.inspect_scene_asset
tools.description: Inspect a selected immutable cloud version or bundled example; returns geometry identity and valid component targets, never raw provider data.

tools.name: astra.create_scene
tools.description: Validate and persist a complete scene for the CLI account. request_id is a caller-generated UUID and also the new scene ID; reuse it only for an identical retry. Returns private head and immutable revision URLs.

tools.name: astra.update_scene
tools.description: Replace an owned scene with a complete validated request using an explicit base_revision. Stale updates return a recoverable conflict. Use a new request_id per edit and reuse it for identical retries.

tools.name: astra.read_scene
tools.description: Read an owned scene head or immutable revision as an editable typed scene request. Does not modify the local workbench or return credentials/raw project data.

tools.name: astra.game_describe
tools.description: Discover city-dump runtime v2 scope and authority requirements. This static contract does not assert deployment readiness or full-game support.

tools.name: astra.game_create_match
tools.description: Create a waiting two-player city-dump match. Requires ASTRA_GAME_TOOLS_ENABLED=true, an OpenIndustries game session and the independent SQLite runtime service. Returns a one-use invite code for deliberate sharing.

tools.name: astra.game_join_match
tools.description: Consume the host’s invite code as the second distinct authenticated participant. No caller-supplied player identity. An identical command retry returns the original receipt.

tools.name: astra.game_read_match
tools.description: Read a full participant-scoped reconnect snapshot, catching durable jobs up to database time. Replace local state; do not infer opponent inventory from shared revisions.

tools.name: astra.game_command
tools.description: Issue a version-checked authoritative command. Inspect before collection, then process the owned batch. Recipe, time, power and yields are server-owned. Read after CONFLICT and submit a new command ID; retry uncertain outcomes with the identical ID and payload.

tools.name: astra.read_animation_feedback
tools.description: Read the latest scrubbed Mergence authored-animation review for Form iteration.

tools.name: astra.read_form_project
tools.description: Read a local compiled Form project manifest from the Mergence checkout.

tools.name: astra.save_form_project
tools.description: Save a Form MCP project_ir back into an existing compiled project manifest.

tools.name: astra.list_feedback
tools.description: List available Mergence animation feedback packages.

tools.name: astra.write_space_brief
tools.description: Record a space requirement for the Mergence local demo planner.

readiness.message: The SQLite processing contract is verified. Full-game startup remains disabled: robots, manufacturing, combat and victory are missing.
requiredCapabilities: Persistent server clock and restart recovery
Hidden deposits and per-player sensor observations
Authoritative material processing and energy accounting
Robot jobs, construction, combat, and victory
